options.A: cohesion of water molecules to one another by hydrogen bonds
options.B: force of gravity attracting the water molecules through the hydrogen bonds
options.C: attraction between the water and xylem by osmotic force
options.D: normal flow of water from the ground with the help of gravitational force

candidate.explanation: Hydrogen bonds between water molecules produce cohesion. This helps maintain a continuous column of water in xylem as transpiration creates tension. Attraction to the vessel walls is adhesion, a different interaction.
